SELECT `booking`.`booking_id`, `account`.`prefix` AS `currency`, IFNULL(payments.tran_paid_amount,0) AS `tran_paid_amount`, IFNULL(payments.sub_16_paid,0) AS `sub_16_paid`, IFNULL(payments.sub_0_paid,0) AS `sub_0_paid`, IFNULL(payments.tax_16_paid,0) AS `tax_16_paid`, IFNULL(payments.tax_ret_paid,0) AS `tax_ret_paid`, IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) AS `subtotal_VAT0`, IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) AS `subtotal_VAT16`, `transaction`.`request_id`, `transaction`.`invoice`, `transaction`.`cancelled`, `transaction`.`invoice_type`, `transaction`.`payment_request`, `transaction`.`paid`, `transaction`.`pdf_attach`, `transaction`.`xml_attach`, `transaction`.`seal`, `transaction`.`transc_id`, `transaction`.`tran_date`, `transaction`.`tran_number`, `transaction`.`tran_type`, `transaction`.`booking`, (CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END ) AS `exchange_value`, IFNULL(payments.paid_exchange_value, 0) AS `paid_exchange_value`, `transaction`.`account`, `transaction`.`account` AS `account_id`, `transaction`.`company_id`, `company`.`name` AS `companyName`, `transaction`.`vendor`, `transaction`.`customer`, `transaction`.`modified_by`, `booking`.`booking_number`, `booking`.`created_at` AS `booking_created_at`, `vendor`.`fullName` AS `vendorName`, `customer`.`fullName` AS `customerName`, SUM(
               CASE WHEN  ((tran_type = 0 AND invoice_type <> 3) OR tran_type = 2 )THEN IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal, 0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END ) 
               ELSE IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal , 0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )  * -1  END
            ) non_dec, SUM(
               CASE WHEN  ((tran_type = 0 AND invoice_type <> 3) OR tran_type = 2 ) THEN IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal, 0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END ) 
               ELSE IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal , 0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )  * -1  END
            ) sub_16_mxn , SUM( 
               CASE WHEN  ((tran_type = 0 AND invoice_type <> 3) OR tran_type = 2 ) THEN IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal, 0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END ) 
               ELSE IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal, 0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )  * -1  END
               ) sub_0_mxn, SUM(
               CASE WHEN  ((tran_type = 0 AND invoice_type <> 3) OR tran_type = 2 ) THEN IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount, 0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END ) 
               ELSE IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount, 0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )  * -1  END
           ) tax_16_mxn, SUM(
               CASE WHEN  ((tran_type = 0 AND invoice_type <> 3) OR tran_type = 2 )THEN IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet, 0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END ) 
               ELSE IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet, 0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )  * -1  END
               ) tax_ret_mxn, SUM(
               CASE WHEN  ((tran_type = 0 AND invoice_type <> 3) OR tran_type = 2 )THEN IFNULL(VAT0.taxAmount, 0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )  
               ELSE IFNULL(VAT0.taxAmount,0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )  * -1  END
               ) tax_0_mxn, SUM( 
                IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal, 0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0)
               ) amount_original, SUM( 
               CASE WHEN  ((tran_type = 0 AND invoice_type <> 3) OR tran_type = 2 ) THEN 
                    ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) +  IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )
               ELSE 
                    ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )  * -1  
               END
            )  total_amount, SUM(
               CASE WHEN  ((tran_type = 0 AND invoice_type <> 3) OR tran_type = 2 ) THEN
                    ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )
               ELSE
                    ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )  * -1 
               END
            ) * IFNULL(payments.paid_exchange_value, 0) total_amount_paid_tc, SUM(
               CASE WHEN  ((tran_type = 0 AND invoice_type <> 3) OR tran_type = 2 ) THEN
                    ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) )  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )
               ELSE
                    ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) )  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )  * -1 
               END
            ) amount_original_mxn, SUM(
               CASE WHEN  ((tran_type = 0 AND invoice_type <> 3) OR tran_type = 2 ) THEN
                    ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) )
               ELSE
                    ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) )  * -1 
               END
            ) * IFNULL(payments.paid_exchange_value, 0) amount_original_paid_mxn, CASE WHEN  ((tran_type = 0 AND invoice_type <> 3) OR tran_type = 2 ) THEN SUM( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )
             ELSE
             SUM( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )  * -1  
             END
             total_natural_amount, CASE WHEN  ((tran_type = 0 AND invoice_type <> 3) OR tran_type = 2 ) THEN SUM( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) ) - ABS(SUM( IFNULL( payments.tran_paid_amount, 0 ) ) )  

           ELSE

            ( SUM( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) ) - ABS(SUM( IFNULL( payments.tran_paid_amount, 0 ) ) ) ) * -1  

           END

           left_to_pay, SUM(
               CASE WHEN  ((tran_type = 0 AND invoice_type <> 3) OR tran_type = 2 ) THEN
                    (IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) )  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )
               ELSE
                    0
               END
            )  income, SUM(
               CASE WHEN  ((tran_type = 0 AND invoice_type <> 3) OR tran_type = 2 ) THEN
                   0
               ELSE
                     (IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) )  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )
               END
            )  expense FROM `transaction` LEFT JOIN `booking` ON `transaction`.`booking` = `booking`.`booking_id` LEFT JOIN `provider` `vendor` ON `transaction`.`vendor` = `vendor`.`provider_id` LEFT JOIN `client` `customer` ON `transaction`.`customer` = `customer`.`client_id` LEFT JOIN `account` ON `transaction`.`account` = `account`.`account_id` LEFT JOIN `company` `company` ON `transaction`.`company_id` = `company`.`company_id` LEFT JOIN `payment_request` ON `transaction`.`request_id` = `payment_request`.`request_id` LEFT JOIN (SELECT `transaction`, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * IFNULL(quantity, 0) ) AS `subtotal`, SUM(IFNULL(price,0) * 
            IFNULL(quantity,0) * 
            IFNULL(charge_type.tax_rate , 0) ) taxAmount, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * 
            IFNULL(quantity,0)  * 
            IFNULL(charge_type.tax_retention , 0) ) taxtRet FROM `charge` LEFT JOIN `charge_type` ON charge_type.charge_type_id = charge.type WHERE (`tax_rate`=0.16) AND (`non_deductible`=0) GROUP BY `charge`.`transaction`) `VAT16` ON VAT16.transaction = transaction.transc_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT `transaction`, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * IFNULL(quantity, 0) ) AS `subtotal`, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * 
            IFNULL(quantity,0) * 
            IFNULL(charge_type.tax_rate, 0) ) taxAmount FROM `charge` LEFT JOIN `charge_type` ON charge_type.charge_type_id = charge.type WHERE (`tax_rate`=0) AND (`non_deductible`=0) GROUP BY `charge`.`transaction`) `VAT0` ON VAT0.transaction = transaction.transc_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT `transaction`, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * IFNULL(quantity, 0) ) AS `subtotal`, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * 
            IFNULL(quantity,0) * 
            IFNULL(charge_type.tax_rate, 0) ) taxAmount FROM `charge` LEFT JOIN `charge_type` ON charge_type.charge_type_id = charge.type WHERE (`tax_rate`=0) AND (`non_deductible`=1) GROUP BY `charge`.`transaction`) `nonDec` ON nonDec.transaction = transaction.transc_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT `transc_id`, SUM( IFNULL(payments_by_transaction.amount,0)  ) AS `tran_paid_amount`, `VAT16`.`subtotal`,  ( IFNULL(payments_by_transaction.amount,0) / ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) +   IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )   )  , SUM( ( IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0)   ) *  ( IFNULL(payments_by_transaction.amount,0) / ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) +   IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )   )  ) AS `sub_16_paid`, SUM( ( IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal, 0)   ) *  ( IFNULL(payments_by_transaction.amount,0) / ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) +   IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )   )  ) AS `sub_0_paid`, SUM( ( IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount, 0) ) *  ( IFNULL(payments_by_transaction.amount,0) / ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) +   IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )   )  ) AS `tax_16_paid`, SUM( ( IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet, 0)   ) *  ( IFNULL(payments_by_transaction.amount,0) / ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) +   IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )   )  ) AS `tax_ret_paid`, SUM(  ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0)) *  ( IFNULL(payments_by_transaction.amount,0) / ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) +   IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )   )   ) AS `total_paid`, SUM(  ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0)) *  ( IFNULL(payments_by_transaction.amount,0) / ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) +   IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )   )  ) AS `amount_original_paid`, SUM( IFNULL(payments_by_transaction.amount,0) * IFNULL(exchange_req.exchange_value, 1) ) / NULLIF( SUM( IFNULL(payments_by_transaction.amount,0) ), 0 ) AS `paid_exchange_value` FROM `payments_by_transaction` LEFT JOIN `payment_request` ON payment_request.request_id = payments_by_transaction.request_id LEFT JOIN `account` ON payment_request.currency_id = account.account_id  LEFT JOIN `exchange` `exchange_req` ON (payment_request.currency_id = exchange_req.account AND `payment_request`.date = exchange_req.date_exchange) OR  
         (payment_request.currency_id = exchange_req.account AND account.`default` = 1 )
         LEFT JOIN (SELECT `transaction`, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * IFNULL(quantity, 0) ) AS `subtotal`, SUM(IFNULL(price,0) * 
            IFNULL(quantity,0) * 
            IFNULL(charge_type.tax_rate , 0) ) taxAmount, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * 
            IFNULL(quantity,0)  * 
            IFNULL(charge_type.tax_retention , 0) ) taxtRet FROM `charge` LEFT JOIN `charge_type` ON charge_type.charge_type_id = charge.type WHERE (`tax_rate`=0.16) AND (`non_deductible`=0) GROUP BY `charge`.`transaction`) `VAT16` ON VAT16.transaction = payments_by_transaction.transc_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT `transaction`, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * IFNULL(quantity, 0) ) AS `subtotal`, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * 
            IFNULL(quantity,0) * 
            IFNULL(charge_type.tax_rate, 0) ) taxAmount FROM `charge` LEFT JOIN `charge_type` ON charge_type.charge_type_id = charge.type WHERE (`tax_rate`=0) AND (`non_deductible`=0) GROUP BY `charge`.`transaction`) `VAT0` ON VAT0.transaction = payments_by_transaction.transc_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT `transaction`, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * IFNULL(quantity, 0) ) AS `subtotal`, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * 
            IFNULL(quantity,0) * 
            IFNULL(charge_type.tax_rate, 0) ) taxAmount FROM `charge` LEFT JOIN `charge_type` ON charge_type.charge_type_id = charge.type WHERE (`tax_rate`=0) AND (`non_deductible`=1) GROUP BY `charge`.`transaction`) `nonDec` ON nonDec.transaction = payments_by_transaction.transc_id GROUP BY `payments_by_transaction`.`transc_id`) `payments` ON  payments.transc_id  =  transaction.transc_id LEFT JOIN `exchange` ON (account.account_id = exchange.account AND `transaction`.tran_date = exchange.date_exchange  ) OR  
         (account.account_id = exchange.account AND  account.`default` = 1 )
          WHERE (`booking`.`mode`=10) AND (`tran_type`=0) AND (`transaction`.`cancelled`=0) GROUP BY `transaction`.`transc_id`

SELECT `booking`.`booking_id`, `account`.`prefix` AS `currency`, IFNULL(payments.tran_paid_amount,0) AS `tran_paid_amount`, IFNULL(payments.sub_16_paid,0) AS `sub_16_paid`, IFNULL(payments.sub_0_paid,0) AS `sub_0_paid`, IFNULL(payments.tax_16_paid,0) AS `tax_16_paid`, IFNULL(payments.tax_ret_paid,0) AS `tax_ret_paid`, IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) AS `subtotal_VAT0`, IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) AS `subtotal_VAT16`, `transaction`.`request_id`, `transaction`.`invoice`, `transaction`.`cancelled`, `transaction`.`invoice_type`, `transaction`.`payment_request`, `transaction`.`paid`, `transaction`.`pdf_attach`, `transaction`.`xml_attach`, `transaction`.`seal`, `transaction`.`transc_id`, `transaction`.`tran_date`, `transaction`.`tran_number`, `transaction`.`tran_type`, `transaction`.`booking`, (CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END ) AS `exchange_value`, IFNULL(payments.paid_exchange_value, 0) AS `paid_exchange_value`, `transaction`.`account`, `transaction`.`account` AS `account_id`, `transaction`.`company_id`, `company`.`name` AS `companyName`, `transaction`.`vendor`, `transaction`.`customer`, `transaction`.`modified_by`, `booking`.`booking_number`, `booking`.`created_at` AS `booking_created_at`, `vendor`.`fullName` AS `vendorName`, `customer`.`fullName` AS `customerName`, SUM(
               CASE WHEN  ((tran_type = 0 AND invoice_type <> 3) OR tran_type = 2 )THEN IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal, 0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END ) 
               ELSE IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal , 0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )  * -1  END
            ) non_dec, SUM(
               CASE WHEN  ((tran_type = 0 AND invoice_type <> 3) OR tran_type = 2 ) THEN IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal, 0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END ) 
               ELSE IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal , 0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )  * -1  END
            ) sub_16_mxn , SUM( 
               CASE WHEN  ((tran_type = 0 AND invoice_type <> 3) OR tran_type = 2 ) THEN IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal, 0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END ) 
               ELSE IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal, 0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )  * -1  END
               ) sub_0_mxn, SUM(
               CASE WHEN  ((tran_type = 0 AND invoice_type <> 3) OR tran_type = 2 ) THEN IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount, 0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END ) 
               ELSE IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount, 0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )  * -1  END
           ) tax_16_mxn, SUM(
               CASE WHEN  ((tran_type = 0 AND invoice_type <> 3) OR tran_type = 2 )THEN IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet, 0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END ) 
               ELSE IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet, 0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )  * -1  END
               ) tax_ret_mxn, SUM(
               CASE WHEN  ((tran_type = 0 AND invoice_type <> 3) OR tran_type = 2 )THEN IFNULL(VAT0.taxAmount, 0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )  
               ELSE IFNULL(VAT0.taxAmount,0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )  * -1  END
               ) tax_0_mxn, SUM( 
                IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal, 0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0)
               ) amount_original, SUM( 
               CASE WHEN  ((tran_type = 0 AND invoice_type <> 3) OR tran_type = 2 ) THEN 
                    ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) +  IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )
               ELSE 
                    ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )  * -1  
               END
            )  total_amount, SUM(
               CASE WHEN  ((tran_type = 0 AND invoice_type <> 3) OR tran_type = 2 ) THEN
                    ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )
               ELSE
                    ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )  * -1 
               END
            ) * IFNULL(payments.paid_exchange_value, 0) total_amount_paid_tc, SUM(
               CASE WHEN  ((tran_type = 0 AND invoice_type <> 3) OR tran_type = 2 ) THEN
                    ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) )  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )
               ELSE
                    ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) )  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )  * -1 
               END
            ) amount_original_mxn, SUM(
               CASE WHEN  ((tran_type = 0 AND invoice_type <> 3) OR tran_type = 2 ) THEN
                    ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) )
               ELSE
                    ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) )  * -1 
               END
            ) * IFNULL(payments.paid_exchange_value, 0) amount_original_paid_mxn, CASE WHEN  ((tran_type = 0 AND invoice_type <> 3) OR tran_type = 2 ) THEN SUM( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )
             ELSE
             SUM( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )  * -1  
             END
             total_natural_amount, CASE WHEN  ((tran_type = 0 AND invoice_type <> 3) OR tran_type = 2 ) THEN SUM( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) ) - ABS(SUM( IFNULL( payments.tran_paid_amount, 0 ) ) )  

           ELSE

            ( SUM( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) ) - ABS(SUM( IFNULL( payments.tran_paid_amount, 0 ) ) ) ) * -1  

           END

           left_to_pay, SUM(
               CASE WHEN  ((tran_type = 0 AND invoice_type <> 3) OR tran_type = 2 ) THEN
                    (IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) )  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )
               ELSE
                    0
               END
            )  income, SUM(
               CASE WHEN  ((tran_type = 0 AND invoice_type <> 3) OR tran_type = 2 ) THEN
                   0
               ELSE
                     (IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) )  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )
               END
            )  expense FROM `transaction` LEFT JOIN `booking` ON `transaction`.`booking` = `booking`.`booking_id` LEFT JOIN `provider` `vendor` ON `transaction`.`vendor` = `vendor`.`provider_id` LEFT JOIN `client` `customer` ON `transaction`.`customer` = `customer`.`client_id` LEFT JOIN `account` ON `transaction`.`account` = `account`.`account_id` LEFT JOIN `company` `company` ON `transaction`.`company_id` = `company`.`company_id` LEFT JOIN `payment_request` ON `transaction`.`request_id` = `payment_request`.`request_id` LEFT JOIN (SELECT `transaction`, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * IFNULL(quantity, 0) ) AS `subtotal`, SUM(IFNULL(price,0) * 
            IFNULL(quantity,0) * 
            IFNULL(charge_type.tax_rate , 0) ) taxAmount, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * 
            IFNULL(quantity,0)  * 
            IFNULL(charge_type.tax_retention , 0) ) taxtRet FROM `charge` LEFT JOIN `charge_type` ON charge_type.charge_type_id = charge.type WHERE (`tax_rate`=0.16) AND (`non_deductible`=0) GROUP BY `charge`.`transaction`) `VAT16` ON VAT16.transaction = transaction.transc_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT `transaction`, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * IFNULL(quantity, 0) ) AS `subtotal`, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * 
            IFNULL(quantity,0) * 
            IFNULL(charge_type.tax_rate, 0) ) taxAmount FROM `charge` LEFT JOIN `charge_type` ON charge_type.charge_type_id = charge.type WHERE (`tax_rate`=0) AND (`non_deductible`=0) GROUP BY `charge`.`transaction`) `VAT0` ON VAT0.transaction = transaction.transc_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT `transaction`, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * IFNULL(quantity, 0) ) AS `subtotal`, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * 
            IFNULL(quantity,0) * 
            IFNULL(charge_type.tax_rate, 0) ) taxAmount FROM `charge` LEFT JOIN `charge_type` ON charge_type.charge_type_id = charge.type WHERE (`tax_rate`=0) AND (`non_deductible`=1) GROUP BY `charge`.`transaction`) `nonDec` ON nonDec.transaction = transaction.transc_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT `transc_id`, SUM( IFNULL(payments_by_transaction.amount,0)  ) AS `tran_paid_amount`, `VAT16`.`subtotal`,  ( IFNULL(payments_by_transaction.amount,0) / ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) +   IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )   )  , SUM( ( IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0)   ) *  ( IFNULL(payments_by_transaction.amount,0) / ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) +   IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )   )  ) AS `sub_16_paid`, SUM( ( IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal, 0)   ) *  ( IFNULL(payments_by_transaction.amount,0) / ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) +   IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )   )  ) AS `sub_0_paid`, SUM( ( IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount, 0) ) *  ( IFNULL(payments_by_transaction.amount,0) / ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) +   IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )   )  ) AS `tax_16_paid`, SUM( ( IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet, 0)   ) *  ( IFNULL(payments_by_transaction.amount,0) / ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) +   IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )   )  ) AS `tax_ret_paid`, SUM(  ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0)) *  ( IFNULL(payments_by_transaction.amount,0) / ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) +   IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )   )   ) AS `total_paid`, SUM(  ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0)) *  ( IFNULL(payments_by_transaction.amount,0) / ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) +   IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )   )  ) AS `amount_original_paid`, SUM( IFNULL(payments_by_transaction.amount,0) * IFNULL(exchange_req.exchange_value, 1) ) / NULLIF( SUM( IFNULL(payments_by_transaction.amount,0) ), 0 ) AS `paid_exchange_value` FROM `payments_by_transaction` LEFT JOIN `payment_request` ON payment_request.request_id = payments_by_transaction.request_id LEFT JOIN `account` ON payment_request.currency_id = account.account_id  LEFT JOIN `exchange` `exchange_req` ON (payment_request.currency_id = exchange_req.account AND `payment_request`.date = exchange_req.date_exchange) OR  
         (payment_request.currency_id = exchange_req.account AND account.`default` = 1 )
         LEFT JOIN (SELECT `transaction`, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * IFNULL(quantity, 0) ) AS `subtotal`, SUM(IFNULL(price,0) * 
            IFNULL(quantity,0) * 
            IFNULL(charge_type.tax_rate , 0) ) taxAmount, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * 
            IFNULL(quantity,0)  * 
            IFNULL(charge_type.tax_retention , 0) ) taxtRet FROM `charge` LEFT JOIN `charge_type` ON charge_type.charge_type_id = charge.type WHERE (`tax_rate`=0.16) AND (`non_deductible`=0) GROUP BY `charge`.`transaction`) `VAT16` ON VAT16.transaction = payments_by_transaction.transc_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT `transaction`, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * IFNULL(quantity, 0) ) AS `subtotal`, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * 
            IFNULL(quantity,0) * 
            IFNULL(charge_type.tax_rate, 0) ) taxAmount FROM `charge` LEFT JOIN `charge_type` ON charge_type.charge_type_id = charge.type WHERE (`tax_rate`=0) AND (`non_deductible`=0) GROUP BY `charge`.`transaction`) `VAT0` ON VAT0.transaction = payments_by_transaction.transc_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT `transaction`, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * IFNULL(quantity, 0) ) AS `subtotal`, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * 
            IFNULL(quantity,0) * 
            IFNULL(charge_type.tax_rate, 0) ) taxAmount FROM `charge` LEFT JOIN `charge_type` ON charge_type.charge_type_id = charge.type WHERE (`tax_rate`=0) AND (`non_deductible`=1) GROUP BY `charge`.`transaction`) `nonDec` ON nonDec.transaction = payments_by_transaction.transc_id GROUP BY `payments_by_transaction`.`transc_id`) `payments` ON  payments.transc_id  =  transaction.transc_id LEFT JOIN `exchange` ON (account.account_id = exchange.account AND `transaction`.tran_date = exchange.date_exchange  ) OR  
         (account.account_id = exchange.account AND  account.`default` = 1 )
          WHERE (`booking`.`mode`=10) AND (`tran_type`=0) AND (`seal` LIKE '%A%') AND (`transaction`.`cancelled`=0) GROUP BY `transaction`.`transc_id`

sql:
SELECT `booking`.`booking_id`, `account`.`prefix` AS `currency`, IFNULL(payments.tran_paid_amount,0) AS `tran_paid_amount`, IFNULL(payments.sub_16_paid,0) AS `sub_16_paid`, IFNULL(payments.sub_0_paid,0) AS `sub_0_paid`, IFNULL(payments.tax_16_paid,0) AS `tax_16_paid`, IFNULL(payments.tax_ret_paid,0) AS `tax_ret_paid`, IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) AS `subtotal_VAT0`, IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) AS `subtotal_VAT16`, `transaction`.`request_id`, `transaction`.`invoice`, `transaction`.`cancelled`, `transaction`.`invoice_type`, `transaction`.`payment_request`, `transaction`.`paid`, `transaction`.`pdf_attach`, `transaction`.`xml_attach`, `transaction`.`seal`, `transaction`.`transc_id`, `transaction`.`tran_date`, `transaction`.`tran_number`, `transaction`.`tran_type`, `transaction`.`booking`, (CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END ) AS `exchange_value`, IFNULL(payments.paid_exchange_value, 0) AS `paid_exchange_value`, `transaction`.`account`, `transaction`.`account` AS `account_id`, `transaction`.`company_id`, `company`.`name` AS `companyName`, `transaction`.`vendor`, `transaction`.`customer`, `transaction`.`modified_by`, `booking`.`booking_number`, `booking`.`created_at` AS `booking_created_at`, `vendor`.`fullName` AS `vendorName`, `customer`.`fullName` AS `customerName`, SUM(
               CASE WHEN  (tran_type <> 2 AND invoice_type <> 3 ) THEN IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal, 0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END ) 
               ELSE IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal , 0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )  * -1  END
            ) non_dec, SUM(
               CASE WHEN  (tran_type <> 2 AND invoice_type <> 3 )  THEN IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal, 0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END ) 
               ELSE IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal , 0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )  * -1  END
            ) sub_16_mxn , SUM( 
               CASE WHEN  (tran_type <> 2 AND invoice_type <> 3 )  THEN IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal, 0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END ) 
               ELSE IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal, 0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )  * -1  END
               ) sub_0_mxn, SUM(
               CASE WHEN  (tran_type <> 2 AND invoice_type <> 3 )  THEN IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount, 0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END ) 
               ELSE IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount, 0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )  * -1  END
           ) tax_16_mxn, SUM(
               CASE WHEN  (tran_type <> 2 AND invoice_type <> 3 ) THEN IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet, 0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END ) 
               ELSE IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet, 0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )  * -1  END
               ) tax_ret_mxn, SUM(
               CASE WHEN  (tran_type <> 2 AND invoice_type <> 3 ) THEN IFNULL(VAT0.taxAmount, 0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )  
               ELSE IFNULL(VAT0.taxAmount,0)  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )  * -1  END
               ) tax_0_mxn, SUM( 
                IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal, 0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0)
               ) amount_original, SUM( 
               CASE WHEN  (tran_type <> 2 AND invoice_type <> 3 )  THEN 
                    ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) +  IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )
               ELSE 
                    ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )  * -1  
               END
            )  total_amount, SUM(
               CASE WHEN  (tran_type <> 2 AND invoice_type <> 3 )  THEN
                    ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )
               ELSE
                    ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )  * -1 
               END
            ) * IFNULL(payments.paid_exchange_value, 0) total_amount_paid_tc, SUM(
               CASE WHEN  (tran_type <> 2 AND invoice_type <> 3 )  THEN
                    ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) )  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )
               ELSE
                    ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) )  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )  * -1 
               END
            ) amount_original_mxn, SUM(
               CASE WHEN  (tran_type <> 2 AND invoice_type <> 3 )  THEN
                    ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) )
               ELSE
                    ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) )  * -1 
               END
            ) * IFNULL(payments.paid_exchange_value, 0) amount_original_paid_mxn, CASE WHEN  (tran_type <> 2 AND invoice_type <> 3 )  THEN SUM( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )
             ELSE
             SUM( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )  * -1  
             END
             total_natural_amount, CASE WHEN  (tran_type <> 2 AND invoice_type <> 3 )  THEN SUM( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) ) - ABS(SUM( IFNULL( payments.tran_paid_amount, 0 ) ) )  

           ELSE

            ( SUM( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) ) - ABS(SUM( IFNULL( payments.tran_paid_amount, 0 ) ) ) ) * -1  

           END

           left_to_pay, SUM(
               CASE WHEN  (tran_type <> 2 AND invoice_type <> 3 )  THEN
                    (IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) )  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )
               ELSE
                    0
               END
            )  income, SUM(
               CASE WHEN  (tran_type <> 2 AND invoice_type <> 3 )  THEN
                   0
               ELSE
                     (IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) )  * ( CASE WHEN transaction.custom_tc IS NOT NULL THEN transaction.custom_tc ELSE exchange.exchange_value END )
               END
            )  expense FROM `transaction` LEFT JOIN `booking` ON `transaction`.`booking` = `booking`.`booking_id` LEFT JOIN `provider` `vendor` ON `transaction`.`vendor` = `vendor`.`provider_id` LEFT JOIN `client` `customer` ON `transaction`.`customer` = `customer`.`client_id` LEFT JOIN `account` ON `transaction`.`account` = `account`.`account_id` LEFT JOIN `company` `company` ON `transaction`.`company_id` = `company`.`company_id` LEFT JOIN `payment_request` ON `transaction`.`request_id` = `payment_request`.`request_id` LEFT JOIN (SELECT `transaction`, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * IFNULL(quantity, 0) ) AS `subtotal`, SUM(IFNULL(price,0) * 
            IFNULL(quantity,0) * 
            IFNULL(charge_type.tax_rate , 0) ) taxAmount, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * 
            IFNULL(quantity,0)  * 
            IFNULL(charge_type.tax_retention , 0) ) taxtRet FROM `charge` LEFT JOIN `charge_type` ON charge_type.charge_type_id = charge.type WHERE (`tax_rate`=0.16) AND (`non_deductible`=0) GROUP BY `charge`.`transaction`) `VAT16` ON VAT16.transaction = transaction.transc_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT `transaction`, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * IFNULL(quantity, 0) ) AS `subtotal`, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * 
            IFNULL(quantity,0) * 
            IFNULL(charge_type.tax_rate, 0) ) taxAmount FROM `charge` LEFT JOIN `charge_type` ON charge_type.charge_type_id = charge.type WHERE (`tax_rate`=0) AND (`non_deductible`=0) GROUP BY `charge`.`transaction`) `VAT0` ON VAT0.transaction = transaction.transc_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT `transaction`, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * IFNULL(quantity, 0) ) AS `subtotal`, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * 
            IFNULL(quantity,0) * 
            IFNULL(charge_type.tax_rate, 0) ) taxAmount FROM `charge` LEFT JOIN `charge_type` ON charge_type.charge_type_id = charge.type WHERE (`tax_rate`=0) AND (`non_deductible`=1) GROUP BY `charge`.`transaction`) `nonDec` ON nonDec.transaction = transaction.transc_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT `transc_id`, SUM( IFNULL(payments_by_transaction.amount,0)  ) AS `tran_paid_amount`, `VAT16`.`subtotal`,  ( IFNULL(payments_by_transaction.amount,0) / ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) +   IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )   )  , SUM( ( IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0)   ) *  ( IFNULL(payments_by_transaction.amount,0) / ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) +   IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )   )  ) AS `sub_16_paid`, SUM( ( IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal, 0)   ) *  ( IFNULL(payments_by_transaction.amount,0) / ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) +   IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )   )  ) AS `sub_0_paid`, SUM( ( IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount, 0) ) *  ( IFNULL(payments_by_transaction.amount,0) / ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) +   IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )   )  ) AS `tax_16_paid`, SUM( ( IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet, 0)   ) *  ( IFNULL(payments_by_transaction.amount,0) / ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) +   IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )   )  ) AS `tax_ret_paid`, SUM(  ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0)) *  ( IFNULL(payments_by_transaction.amount,0) / ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) +   IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )   )   ) AS `total_paid`, SUM(  ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0)) *  ( IFNULL(payments_by_transaction.amount,0) / ( IFNULL(nonDec.subtotal,0) +   IFNULL(VAT16.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT0.subtotal,0) + IFNULL(VAT16.taxAmount,0) - IFNULL(VAT16.taxtRet,0) )   )  ) AS `amount_original_paid`, SUM( IFNULL(payments_by_transaction.amount,0) * IFNULL(exchange_req.exchange_value, 1) ) / NULLIF( SUM( IFNULL(payments_by_transaction.amount,0) ), 0 ) AS `paid_exchange_value` FROM `payments_by_transaction` LEFT JOIN `payment_request` ON payment_request.request_id = payments_by_transaction.request_id LEFT JOIN `account` ON payment_request.currency_id = account.account_id  LEFT JOIN `exchange` `exchange_req` ON (payment_request.currency_id = exchange_req.account AND `payment_request`.date = exchange_req.date_exchange) OR  
         (payment_request.currency_id = exchange_req.account AND account.`default` = 1 )
         LEFT JOIN (SELECT `transaction`, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * IFNULL(quantity, 0) ) AS `subtotal`, SUM(IFNULL(price,0) * 
            IFNULL(quantity,0) * 
            IFNULL(charge_type.tax_rate , 0) ) taxAmount, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * 
            IFNULL(quantity,0)  * 
            IFNULL(charge_type.tax_retention , 0) ) taxtRet FROM `charge` LEFT JOIN `charge_type` ON charge_type.charge_type_id = charge.type WHERE (`tax_rate`=0.16) AND (`non_deductible`=0) GROUP BY `charge`.`transaction`) `VAT16` ON VAT16.transaction = payments_by_transaction.transc_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT `transaction`, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * IFNULL(quantity, 0) ) AS `subtotal`, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * 
            IFNULL(quantity,0) * 
            IFNULL(charge_type.tax_rate, 0) ) taxAmount FROM `charge` LEFT JOIN `charge_type` ON charge_type.charge_type_id = charge.type WHERE (`tax_rate`=0) AND (`non_deductible`=0) GROUP BY `charge`.`transaction`) `VAT0` ON VAT0.transaction = payments_by_transaction.transc_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT `transaction`, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * IFNULL(quantity, 0) ) AS `subtotal`, SUM(IFNULL(price, 0) * 
            IFNULL(quantity,0) * 
            IFNULL(charge_type.tax_rate, 0) ) taxAmount FROM `charge` LEFT JOIN `charge_type` ON charge_type.charge_type_id = charge.type WHERE (`tax_rate`=0) AND (`non_deductible`=1) GROUP BY `charge`.`transaction`) `nonDec` ON nonDec.transaction = payments_by_transaction.transc_id GROUP BY `payments_by_transaction`.`transc_id`) `payments` ON  payments.transc_id  =  transaction.transc_id LEFT JOIN `exchange` ON (account.account_id = exchange.account AND `transaction`.tran_date = exchange.date_exchange  ) OR  
         (account.account_id = exchange.account AND  account.`default` = 1 )
          WHERE (`booking`.`mode`=10) AND (`tran_type`=0) AND (`transaction`.`cancelled`=0) GROUP BY `transaction`.`transc_id`
